title: amoria pallescens
intro: Amoria pallescens, commonly known as the "Moonlight Orchid," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The Moonlight Orchid is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Amoria pallescens include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Moonlight Orchid include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
